messages:
nisha_sec: Quick sync — external pen-test dry run tomorrow 09:30 PT. Goal: validate ephemeral RBAC, presign upload flow, and audit-tagging. Who can own staging side?

sam_sre: I can. Plan: mint STS creds scoped to `s3:PutObject` on prefix `pt-2026-04/*`, no KMS actions. We'll tag STS creds with `pt_run=ext-2026-04` so CloudTrail is filterable.

claire_ops: For uploads, prefer presigned POST with bucket-level default KMS key. That avoids giving assessors any KMS perms. We'll enforce object key pattern and content-type.

omar_kms: Confirmed: bucket default-encryption with CMK works. Important: do not require `x-amz-server-side-encryption` in presign to keep KMS out of the request. Also we'll add a condition in the bucket policy to restrict uploads to the presigned gateway principal.

julia_cs: Ops, can you post a 1-line example for assessors? They asked for curl or JS snippet.

sam_sre: Example curl we'll provide in staging: `curl -F "key=pt-2026-04/assessor1/20260401_0915.tgz" -F "file=@artifact.tgz" https://presign.gateway/upload` The gateway will return the form fields.

nisha_sec: Retention: staging bucket lifecycle 45 days, prod 30 days. Evidence naming conventions: `<pt-id>/<assessor-id>/<ts>_<sha256>.tgz`. Size cap 8GB per object; multipart required above 100MB.

security-bot: New ticket SEC-2026-1299 created: "PT dry-run: presign + RBAC snapshot" (assignee: sam_sre; due: 2026-04-02).

claire_ops: RBAC snapshot plan: run `aws iam list-roles` + dump inline policies and role tags, store as `iam-snapshot-<pt-id>.json` next to evidence manifest. We'll also capture `aws sts get-caller-identity` for each minted cred during dry-run.

omar_kms: One more KMS note: don't allow `kms:GenerateDataKey` in any assessor-facing policy. We'll keep crypto operations ops-only and only use the CMK via bucket default.

nisha_sec: Triage & retest policy reminder: critical -> emergency retest (48h), high -> 72h mitigation window; otherwise target 7 days. For the dry-run, we'll validate that traceability (tags + manifests) is end-to-end.

julia_cs: I'll confirm assessor availability and share the dry-run checklist (upload, metadata manifest, and a sample audit query) with them.

sam_sre: I'll post the staging presign endpoint and sample curl by EOD. If anyone sees a blocker, ping me or @nisha_sec. :eyes:
